messages:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT — 2 x high-rate 500s observed for eu-prod/model-inference (last 5m). Paging primary oncall.
Ayesha K.: i'm out on PTO today, sorry. was supposed to be primary for EU but checked my calendar :wave:
Jamal R.: i'm online but in a meeting for the next 20. can be secondary if someone can hold primary until i'm free.
Marco T.: I can grab primary for the next 2 hours if needed, currently local and can join bridge. will need a quick context dump.
incident-bot: Created incident bridge: https://zoom.redwood/incident/2076543210 — auto-posting logs and alert aggregates.
Ravi P.: tagging runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-eu-brief — start at "Initial Triage". TL;DR: check model-serving-prewarm, kv-cache pressure, and recent deploys.
Ayesha K.: @Marco T. quick notes — last deploy yesterday rolled a quantized variant, there was a minor spike then but auto-fallback to non-quantized succeeded. watch for increased tail latency and OOMs.
Marco T.: copying notes. opening the bridge now. joining in 30s.
Lena S.: FYI customer-impact: support flagged 3 customer sessions with degraded responses. Not yet escalated to S1 but SLA might be at risk if persists.
Jamal R.: ok i'm free. i'll stay secondary. Marco, if you need escalation path: paged infra-sre and PM oncall are on the incident channel.
Marco T.: doing quick health checks:
```
# check replicas
kubectl -n eu-prod get pods -l app=model-inference
# check recent logs for OOM
kubectl -n eu-prod logs deploy/model-inference --since=15m | grep -i oom
``` 
Marco T.: seeing higher 502/500s on router pods, 4/12 model replicas show restarted within last 10m. suspect memory pressure.
Ravi P.: if memory pressure, apply temporary scale-up and route traffic to healthy variants. runbook suggests: `route: fallback-model:stable` and bump replica count by +25%.
Marco T.: applied patch to HPA: `kubectl -n eu-prod scale deployment/model-inference --replicas=16` — monitoring.
Ayesha K.: leaving a small set of notes in runbook: if scaling doesn't restore, revert quantized variant and flush prefix cache per steps 6-8.
Lena S.: i've notified support to prepare customer comms if we hit 10% error rate for >15m. keeping them on standby.
Jamal R.: re: handoff — Marco, can you be primary until 21:30 UTC? after that i'll take over and follow up on postmortem owner.
Marco T.: yes I can. I'll own until 21:30 UTC. tagging in the shift rotation doc and updating oncall page.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: primary=Marco T., secondary=Jamal R., previous=Ayesha K. (OOO). Bridge active. :white_check_mark:
Marco T.: closing loop — error rate dropping to baseline after scale. continuing to monitor for 30m and will create incident ticket and assign postmortem if any regression.
Lena S.: thanks all. quick wins: keep an eye on canary traffic and customer sessions. i'll update support threads.
Jamal R.: great. i'll do a formal handover at 21:25 UTC with notes and the `next-steps` checklist.
Ayesha K.: huge thanks everyone for the quick cover. enjoy the rest of the shift :raised_hands:
incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated). Summary will be posted to #postmortems in 2h.
